//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestTaskTestAnswerVariantRepoStoresStructuredAnswersAtomically(t *testing.T) {
	databaseURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
	if databaseURL == "" {
		t.Skip("DATABASE_URL is required for PostgreSQL integration test")
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	pool, err := Connect(ctx, databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect test database: %v", err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()

	const (
		answerID   = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
		studentID  = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
		taskID     = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
		testID     = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004"
		variantAID = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005"
		variantBID = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006"
		groupAID   = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007"
		groupBID   = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000008"
	)

	_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$1`, answerID)
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO student_task_answer (
    id, student_id, task_id, started_at, status, attempt, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,now(),$4,1,now(),now())
`, answerID, studentID, taskID, domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("seed test answer: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_, _ = pool.Exec(context.Background(), `DELETE FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$1`, answerID)
	})

	repository := TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	positionOne := 1
	positionTwo := 2
	singleChoice := []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{
		assessmentSelection("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009", answerID, taskID, testID, variantAID, nil, nil, true, now),
	}
	if err := repository.ReplaceForAnswer(ctx, answerID, singleChoice); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store backward-compatible single-choice answer: %v", err)
	}
	stored, err := repository.ListForAnswer(ctx, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read single-choice answer: %v", err)
	}
	if len(stored) != 1 || stored[0].TaskTestVariantID != variantAID || stored[0].SubmittedOrder != nil || stored[0].SubmittedGroupID != nil {
		t.Fatalf("single-choice readback mismatch: %+v", stored)
	}

	ordering := []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{
		assessmentSelection("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011", answerID, taskID, testID, variantAID, &positionOne, nil, true, now),
		assessmentSelection("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012", answerID, taskID, testID, variantBID, &positionTwo, nil, true, now.Add(time.Millisecond)),
	}
	if err := repository.ReplaceForAnswer(ctx, answerID, ordering); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store ordering answer: %v", err)
	}
	stored, err = repository.ListForAnswer(ctx, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read ordering answer: %v", err)
	}
	if len(stored) != 2 || stored[0].SubmittedOrder == nil || *stored[0].SubmittedOrder != 1 || stored[1].SubmittedOrder == nil || *stored[1].SubmittedOrder != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("ordering readback mismatch: %+v", stored)
	}

	classification := []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{
		assessmentSelection("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000021", answerID, taskID, testID, variantAID, nil, stringPointer(groupAID), true, now),
		assessmentSelection("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000022", answerID, taskID, testID, variantBID, nil, stringPointer(groupBID), true, now.Add(time.Millisecond)),
	}
	if err := repository.ReplaceForAnswer(ctx, answerID, classification); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store classification answer: %v", err)
	}
	stored, err = repository.ListForAnswer(ctx, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read classification answer: %v", err)
	}
	if len(stored) != 2 || stored[0].SubmittedGroupID == nil || *stored[0].SubmittedGroupID != groupAID || stored[1].SubmittedGroupID == nil || *stored[1].SubmittedGroupID != groupBID {
		t.Fatalf("classification readback mismatch: %+v", stored)
	}

	invalidReplacement := []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{
		assessmentSelection("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000031", answerID, taskID, testID, variantAID, &positionOne, nil, true, now),
		assessmentSelection("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000032", answerID, taskID, testID, variantBID, &positionOne, nil, true, now.Add(time.Millisecond)),
	}
	if err := repository.ReplaceForAnswer(ctx, answerID, invalidReplacement); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate submitted order unexpectedly succeeded")
	}
	stored, err = repository.ListForAnswer(ctx, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read answer after rollback: %v", err)
	}
	if len(stored) != 2 || stored[0].SubmittedGroupID == nil || *stored[0].SubmittedGroupID != groupAID {
		t.Fatalf("failed replacement did not roll back atomically: %+v", stored)
	}
}

func assessmentSelection(id, answerID, taskID, testID, variantID string, submittedOrder *int, submittedGroupID *string, correct bool, createdAt time.Time) domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant {
	return domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{
		ID:                  id,
		StudentTaskAnswerID: answerID,
		TaskID:              taskID,
		TaskTestID:          testID,
		TaskTestVariantID:   variantID,
		SubmittedOrder:      submittedOrder,
		SubmittedGroupID:    submittedGroupID,
		IsCorrect:           correct,
		CreatedAt:           createdAt,
	}
}

func stringPointer(value string) *string {
	return &value
}
